name: Fingerpicking for Beginners
instructions: Fingerpicking uses your thumb and fingers to pluck individual strings instead of strumming all of them together.
Start with a simple thumb-index-middle-ring pattern on a single chord before trying to change chords while fingerpicking.
Keep your picking-hand wrist relaxed and slightly arched, not flat against the guitar body.
Watch today's video for a 12-minute introduction to fingerpicking.
